title: Attagasam
desc: Jeeva and Guru are twins who get separated in childhood by their mother in order to save their lives. When they reunite several years later, Guru swaps places with Jeeva.

title: Idhayathai Thirudathe
desc: A terminally ill man decides to live alone on a hill station and falls for a bubbly woman, until he makes a shocking discovery.

title: Villadhi Villain
desc: Meenatchi Sundara Sasthiriyaar, an eminent lawyer, is against the relationship of his daughter with Edison. When Edison is charged for the murder of a minister, he seeks Meenatchi's help.

title: Pudhuvai Managaram
desc: A pair of twin siblings set up an accident rescue unit to save people. Soon, their lives change when they rescue a mysterious girl.

title: Nadodi Pattukkaran
desc: Sundaram, a musician, travels from one place to another along with his troupe. One day, the troupe drives away a group of robbers who terrorise a village and subsequently, they settle there.
